name: camofox-human-auth
external_service: Camofox Browser (patched Camoufox server, local HTTP on 127.0.0.1:9377/9378)
notes: Handoff workflow portable to any Claude browser tool; /admin/display-mode endpoint exists only in the plugin's patched backend. No LICENSE file, 2 upstream skills summarized not copied.

name: chatto-platform
external_service: Chatto self-hosted team chat (ConnectRPC JSON at /api/connect, login at /auth/login)
notes: Outbound login+CreateMessage+ListRooms reproducible via curl per adapter.py; inbound WebSocket protobuf gateway relay not portable. No LICENSE file.

name: clawchat
notes: Gateway platform adapter with activation-code token exchange; no Claude equivalent. Installer @clawling/clawchat-plugin-install-cli 0.4.9 exists on npm but targets Hermes/OpenClaw only.

name: hermes-nous-prices
notes: Hermes Desktop React pane + FastAPI companion importing hermes_cli/agent internals; no external pricing endpoint in source. No LICENSE file.

name: hermes-pets-all
notes: Desktop pet gallery pane plus read-only list_pets over Hermes-internal pet store; no Claude equivalent. MIT but ships no skills/.

name: intelligent_memory
notes: Stdlib-only CLI (search/export/import/status/migrate/project) runs without Hermes from repo plugin/ dir; hooks and cloud extraction not portable. No LICENSE file; not on PyPI.

name: job-search
notes: Repo is itself a Claude Code plugin (.claude-plugin/plugin.json + 7 skills); install via /plugin marketplace add agent-data/job-search. npm agent-data 0.14.0 verified.

name: lancedb
external_service: OpenAI-compatible embeddings API (default OpenAI text-embedding-3-small); LanceDB embedded
notes: Store/recall/forget reproducible with pip lancedb 0.41.0 + openai 3.57.0 (verified); Hermes hooks, auxiliary-LLM extraction and prompt injection not portable. Apache-2.0, no skills/.

name: mindgraph
notes: 5 tools wrap mindgraph-sdk (PyPI 0.18.0 verified, import name mindgraph); SDK method names taken from tools.py, signatures unverified. Session lifecycle/prefetch not portable. MIT, no skills/.

name: obsidian-memory
notes: Vault scan/search/edit/backlinks are plain filesystem ops Claude does directly; force-directed graph pane is Hermes dashboard UI. No LICENSE file.

name: volcengine-voice
external_service: Volcengine Doubao speech (openspeech.bytedance.com TTS v3 HTTP, STT v3 WebSocket; paid)
notes: TTS payload/headers transcribed from tts.py for curl; STT binary WS framing summarized, source is reference. Not executed. No LICENSE file (README says MIT).

name: weather
external_service: api.weather.gov, aviationweather.gov, spc.noaa.gov, api.open-meteo.com (public, no key)
notes: 7 data tools are plain HTTPS per nws.py; imagery/radar/sounding/ECAPE need Rust toolchain and git-sourced packages (metrust 0.5.0 on PyPI verified). No LICENSE file; skill.md summarized.
